channel.title: Marginal Data
channel.description: Small interactive experiments in data and visualization.

item.title: If Wealth Were Land — Marginal Data
item.description: Global wealth inequality redrawn as claimed territory on a world map, sized by each group's share of wealth.

item.title: Possession Shape: Argentina vs. France — Marginal Data
item.description: Comparing each team's average player positioning in and out of possession during the 2022 World Cup Final.

item.title: Passing Triangle Matching Game — Marginal Data
item.description: Match player jerseys to their passing triangles from the 2022 World Cup Final in this quick guessing game.

item.title: Passing Compass — Marginal Data
item.description: Visualizing every pass from the 2022 World Cup Final as a vector, encoding direction and distance on a compass.

item.title: How Marginal Tax Rates Actually Work — Marginal Data
item.description: A scrollytelling walkthrough of how tax brackets apply only to the dollars within them, not your whole income.

item.title: Colorado Voter Affiliation, 2016–2026 — Marginal Data
item.description: A decade of county-level voter registration trends across Colorado, explored with ternary and cartesian charts.

item.title: Expanse-Style Space Travel Simulator — Marginal Data
item.description: A brachistochrone trajectory simulator calculating realistic flip-and-burn travel times between planets.

item.title: How Many 13ers? Colorado Summits Explorer — Marginal Data
item.description: An interactive map and filterable table of all 3,200+ named summits in Colorado, from 14ers to foothills.

item.title: Decision Vectorizer — Marginal Data
item.description: Visualizing decisions as vectors, combining weighted factors to compare options against each other.

item.title: Decision Component Analyzer — Marginal Data
item.description: Breaking a decision down into its weighted components to see what's actually driving the choice.

item.title: Image Scrambler — Marginal Data
item.description: Scramble and reassemble images to explore how puzzle difficulty scales with the number of pieces.

item.title: Solar Generation Explorer — Marginal Data
item.description: An animated look at how solar power generation rises and falls across the day and across seasons.

item.title: How Much More Pizza Is a Large? — Marginal Data
item.description: An interactive pizza-size slider showing how area, not diameter, actually determines how much pizza you get.

item.title: Fuel Economy Curve Visualization — Marginal Data
item.description: Plotting how a vehicle's fuel efficiency changes with speed across its full operating range.

item.title: Compare Vehicle Fuel Efficiency — Marginal Data
item.description: Look up and compare real fuel economy ratings across vehicles side by side.

item.title: How Does US Foreign Aid Rank Globally? — Marginal Data
item.description: Comparing US foreign aid spending against other countries, in absolute dollars and as a share of GDP.

item.title: How Big Is US Federal Employment? — Marginal Data
item.description: Putting the size of the federal workforce in context against state, local, and private-sector employment.

item.title: How Big Was USAID? — Marginal Data
item.description: Guess how large USAID's budget actually was compared to the rest of the federal budget, then see the real numbers.
